commit      = 5573b656c28adcbb673f4018c84a47f50eda0954

commit_date = 2026-08-31
vendored    = 2026-09-01 (into unirl/models/leo2/vendor/gen_ar/)

The vendored runtime contains the Leo2 inference/UniRL closure from the upstream
hymm/ and processors/ source trees, plus source snapshots based on the two
inference-time gitlink revisions below. Model weights and tokenizer/VAE assets remain
external artifacts. The generation configuration and 480p model YAML are
package resources. Upstream datasets, tests, jobs, and .git metadata are not
part of the package.

Submodules pinned by the upstream commit:
  deps/hy_parallelism = a2fb81523b4c35563d7129ff47e5a0955f77d204
  deps/IndexKits      = d83299da6b0efdd87c4e0387d603e5f3721210ce

Dependency snapshot provenance:
  deps/IndexKits is based on d83299da6b0efdd87c4e0387d603e5f3721210ce.
  deps/hy_parallelism is based on a2fb81523b4c35563d7129ff47e5a0955f77d204;
  its package version is 1.1.12. Exclusions are documented below.

Deliberate runtime-only pruning:
  - hymm/trainers, hymm/ptm, hymm/ptm_v2 and hymm/train.py (training entrypoints)
  - hymm/models/reward_models and hymm/metrics (online/evaluation services)
  - non-Leo2 sampler modules (the native Leo2 T2V sampler remains available)
  - all model YAMLs except the required base defaults and validated Leo2 A12B
    480p stage-3 configuration
  - hy_parallelism tests, API examples and tools/taiji (non-runtime tooling)
  - dependency caches, backup files and all nested .git metadata

The UniRL Leo2 pipeline and the retained native T2V sampler do not import the
pruned modules during model construction, conditioning, denoising or VAE
decode. Metric evaluation is intentionally outside this source bundle.
The validated upstream YAML still carries frozen training-data path strings;
inference parses their values for schema compatibility but never opens them.

Not vendored: deps/AngelPTM and deps/VLMEvalKit. They are not imported by the
Leo2 inference bootstrap.

Local integration:
  - unirl.models.leo2.bundle inserts this directory and the two dependency
    roots into sys.path, preserving hymm's upstream absolute imports.
  - unirl.models.leo2.config resolves the default hymm root and Leo2 YAML from
    this tree. User-supplied paths continue to override those defaults.
  - hymm/models/basic/rope_cache.py carries UniRL's exact input-signature cache
    key, explicit reset, and hit/miss counters.
  - hymm/models/basic/flash_attn_no_pad.py accepts both supported FA3 varlen
    signatures and normalizes tuple/tensor returns.
  - hymm/models/diffusion propagates initialize_weights=False into Leo/LeoHF
    so strict DCP loads do not first initialize all 75B parameters.
  - UniRL's bundle validates the pinned mixed BF16/FP32 DCP tensor profile;
    only the checkpoint's BF16 MoE router exception may differ from model init.
  - hymm/constants.py has no site-specific asset fallback; launchers must set
    ASSETS_BASE through the documented LEO2_ASSETS_BASE contract.
  - encrypted-dataset helpers never print any portion of FILE_PASSWORD.
  - hymm/models/diffusion/leo_cache.py plus the Leo model/pipeline integration
    carry UniRL's request-scoped first-block, Taylor, calibrated MagCache and
    FasterCache-style DFR inference caches.

To re-vendor: export the three commits above, replace this tree without .git
metadata, apply the documented runtime-only pruning and local integrations,
then update this file and rerun the wheel-isolation and 8-GPU Leo2 smoke tests.
